sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Festive airdrop crate is a Event Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: Can be called in by using a handheld RSP-30 firework flare on all locations aside from Ground Zero, Factory, The Lab and The Labyrinth.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: During Escape from Tarkov's 2024 Christmas event, this crate could also be found near crashed sleds.
